newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lille airport cargo traffic up 17pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Lille airport cargo traffic up 17pct in November.

text.p: Lille-Lesquin airport, in northern France, handled 2,033 tonnes of cargo traffic last month, up 17 percent on November 1995, airport authority figures show.
In the first 11 months of 1996, the airport handled 22,212 tonnes of freight traffic, an increase of seven percent on the same period last year.

Air France Europe and French handling agent, France Handling, KLM, via its handling unit CSC and DHL, generate the most cargo traffic at Lille Airport. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 538 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
